title: Fixed-object degree-zero mapping adjunction for the prescribed limit
statement: For the normalized DVR tower, coherent finite identifications, and integral limit presentation of lem-coef-integral-dualizing-mapping-limit-hom, fix one constructible object K. The displayed Hom equivalence from K.obj ⟶ M.obj to the coefficient-point Hom from the compact-support tower into the coefficient-unit object exists.
